# Silxor Group Holding

> Enterprise technology consultancy for enterprise and corporate clients.

Silxor helps organizations plan, build, migrate, secure and operate technology across on premises, hybrid and cloud environments. Offerings describe capabilities; scope is agreed per engagement. Technology names do not imply vendor affiliation or certification. No public client results or statistics are asserted by this directory.

## Services
- [Full Product Team as a Service](/services/product-team): A complete senior product team behind your idea, not just developers.
- [IT Strategy & Advisory](/services/advisory): Decisions on architecture, platforms, and risk made with senior engineering judgment.
- [Infrastructure, Networking & Cloud](/services/cloud): Resilient sovereign, private, and hybrid platforms engineered to stay up.
- [Cybersecurity](/services/cybersecurity): Security architecture and evidence that hold up to auditors and attackers.
- [Managed IT & End User Services](/services/managed-services): Senior ownership of your platform after go live, under agreed SLA tiers.
- [Private AI & AI Platforms](/services/private-ai): AI capability inside your own environment, with your data staying there.
- [Identity & Access Management](/services/identity): Govern human, customer, privileged and machine identities across your enterprise.
- [Custom Software Engineering](/services/software-engineering): Custom applications, platforms and integrations built around your business.
- [Custom Hardware, Embedded & IoT](/services/hardware-engineering): Connected hardware and embedded systems engineered alongside your software.
